nodes.directText: The runner daemonset reads its API key from only at startup. Since the daemonset pod starts before we can write the token, we write it and then restart the pod so it picks it up.
nodes.subtreeText: Why the pod restart? The runner daemonset reads its API key from CONFIG_FILE_PATH=/host-token/token.txt only at startup. Since the daemonset pod starts before we can write the token, we write it and then restart the pod so it picks it up.
